Tastehouse
Feb 2026 • Family
The seafood restaurant I visited during my trip to Vietnam was one of the most memorable on this schedule. From the moment I entered the store, the ocean smelled silverish, and the living seafood filled with water continued to show freshness. At the same time as ordering, I could feel that the leadership of the ingredients was definitely different because of the simultaneous rubbing and cooking. Especially the shrimp's flesh was hard and sweet, and the more juicy the shrimp was, the more the ocean's flavor spread. The dishes were full of meat and the sauce was not excessive, but lived the taste of the ingredients to not harm the taste of the ingredients.
The staff were also kind to explain the menu and were able to enjoy more deliciously by telling local sauces and how to eat. The price was satisfying enough considering freshness and quantity. The atmosphere of the dining room added a surrealistic but vibrant ride, and the wind came in from the window seat and it felt cooler. Every time the food came out, it was beyond expectation, and every time the dish was empty, there was insecurity.

Delicious seafood and amazing lobster
Jan 2026 • Family
We visited this restaurant twice during our three-day stay, and it was definitely worth it.
On our first visit we had a variety of fresh seafood, all very well cooked and full of flavor. The second time we chose the lobster, which was excellent and beautifully prepared.
The quality of the food was outstanding, especially considering the very reasonable prices. Portions were generous and everything tasted fresh and authentic.
The owners and staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. Even though their English was limited, it was never an issue and felt completely normal in this context.
Great food, warm hospitality and excellent value for money.
Highly recommended.
